title: Workers in Concrete Water Basin, 1960s Construction Snapshot Photo
description: A group of laborers in hats and work jackets inspect and clear debris in a large, partially flooded concrete basin or water reservoir under construction. A long wooden ladder leans from the wet floor up toward the concrete upper ledge. On the upper grade in the background, a vintage pickup truck sits near stacks of lumber, with a tree line and distant suburban structures visible beneath a clear sky.
